scope: Elements consolidation, category reclassification, codebase cleanup, performance/memory optimization, SEO/AI-readiness, and 3.0.0-beta.0 release prep

tasks.title: Consolidate Hyperlinks into Elements Category
tasks.description: Move and reclassify all Hyperlink methods (addHyperlink, updateHyperlink, removeHyperlink, getHyperlinks, getHyperlink, setHyperlink) strictly under the 'Elements' category. Relocate or merge logic from src/managers/HyperlinkManager.js into the Elements subsystem. Update docs-site/src/data/apiReference.json, features.json, README.md, and .agent memory.

tasks.title: Remove Diagnostics & Validation Category
tasks.description: Deprecate and remove the 'Diagnostics & Validation' category from public documentation, features lists, and API manifests. Remove or internalize non-whitelisted standalone diagnostic routines while retaining necessary internal XML security guards (XXE/entity limits) in core ingestion.

tasks.title: Purge Unnecessary Examples and Test Files
tasks.description: Audit examples/, showcase/, and tests/ directories. Remove obsolete, duplicate, experimental, or unmaintained example scripts and test fixtures. Keep showcase scripts aligned strictly with the official public API boundary and ensure tests cleanly cover production modules.

tasks.title: Remove Unwanted Files from Project Root and Workspace
tasks.description: Audit repository tree and delete abandoned config files, stale build artifacts, temporary log files, obsolete scratch scripts, legacy documentation relics, and stray XML/presentation dump files across the root and subdirectories.

tasks.title: Performance Tuning & Memory Leak Elimination
tasks.description: Audit AST parsing, VFS Map operations, JSZip buffering, and stream handling. Ensure large object references, XML caches, and temporary Buffer allocations are freed or garbage-collected efficiently. Optimize tight loops in text run healing, cell matrix traversals, and embedded workbook updates. Validate sub-millisecond execution and minimal memory footprint under high concurrency.

tasks.title: Optimize src/ Folder Structure & Consolidate Modules
tasks.description: Restructure src/ into a clean, intuitive layout. Eliminate redundant intermediate files, merge fragmented utility files into cohesive domain modules (e.g., coordinate/spatial math, XML helpers), and cleanly partition orchestrator (core/), managers/elements, parsers, and writer.

tasks.title: Apply Strict Category Renaming Across Repository
tasks.description:
Enforce the exact 8 standardized category names across codebase JSDocs, TypeScript typings (index.d.ts), documentation site schemas (apiReference.json, features.json, docsNavigation.json), showcase headers, and README.md:
1. 'Lifecycle & I/O' -> 'Import/Export'
2. 'Slides'
3. 'Text & Placeholders'
4. 'Tables'
5. 'Charts'
6. 'Shapes'
7. 'Images & Media'
8. 'Elements'

tasks.title: Optimize and Prune .agent/ Workspace for Current Status
tasks.description: Update and prune the .agent/ folder (.agentignore, project_summary.md, AGENTS.md, rules/features.md, rules/general.md, memory/architectural-decisions.md). Remove stale references to deprecated categories, update the 8-category architecture map, and keep token/context usage minimal.

tasks.title: Maximize SEO and AI Search Discoverability (Google & AI Search Modes)
tasks.description: Optimize docs-site/, package.json, and README.md for #1 Google ranking and AI search discovery (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Gemini, Claude). Incorporate high-intent search queries ('pptx template update nodejs', 'create pptx template programmatic', 'pure javascript powerpoint template engine', 'serverless pptx generator without office'). Add comprehensive JSON-LD Schema.org markup (SoftwareApplication, HowTo, TechArticle), semantic HTML structure, dynamic sitemap.xml, robots.txt, and llms.txt.

tasks.title: Prepare Final Updates & Release 3.0.0-beta.0
tasks.description: Bump package version to '3.0.0-beta.0' in package.json, package-lock.json, and documentation manifests. Run full test suite (`npm test`), build verification (`npm run build`, `npm run docs:build`), and ensure zero regressions or PowerPoint repair warnings.
